tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List the free AI GTM Engineer and its build modules (installable Claude/Codex skills, each closing one B2B go-to-market leak), plus the bundles you can recommend, claim for free, or buy. Returns slug, name, the problem it solves, price, and detail URL.

tools.name: claim_free_agent
tools.description: Claim a FREE Artemis GTM agent for the claude.ai chat-edition path (a user who installs the free engineer from their buyer library rather than the CLI). tools.name: start_purchase
tools.description: Begin purchase of a PAID Artemis GTM agent or bundle. Returns a hosted Stripe checkout URL to hand to the user — card entry happens on Stripe, never in agent scope. After the user pays, the license lands in their library and can be installed with get_install_command.

tools.name: get_install_command
tools.description: Redeem an Artemis GTM license key into an install. Returns the agent slug, version, a signed download URL, and the one-line npx install command for Claude Code. Works for both free and paid licenses.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_agents, get_install_command · Public sink: claim_free_agent.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_agents, get_install_command · Public sink: claim_free_agent

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
